tables.title: Host Bus Connector (USB Type-C)
tables.context: USB-C host-side connector, two contact rows shown around the connector outline

tables.title: Target Bus Connector (I2C/SPI Header)
tables.context: 10-pin header, pins numbered 1-10 (odd numbers top row 9-7-5-3-1, even numbers bottom row 10-8-6-4-2)

rows.label: Pin 1
values: I2C interface clock signal. There is an internal 4.7KOHM pull-up resistor. This pin can be used as GPIO.

rows.label: Pin 3
values: I2C interface data signal. There is an internal 4.7KOHM pull-up resistor. This pin can be used as GPIO.

rows.label: Pin 5
values: SPI interface master in slave out signal. This pin can be used as GPIO.

rows.label: Pin 7
values: SPI interface clock signal. This pin can be used as GPIO.

rows.label: Pin 8
values: SPI interface master out slave in signal. This pin can be used as GPIO.

rows.label: Pin 9
values: SPI interface slave select signal. This pin can be used as GPIO.

notes: Unless otherwise specified, all dimensions are in millimeters (title block general note).
Front panel shows PWR and ACT LED indicators, a TYPE-C port, CE/FCC/WEEE markings, www.deico.com.tr text, and a small 2x5 pinheader outlined in red matching the Target Bus Connector pins.
Product is labeled 'Onyx I2C/SPI' with 'DE4001 USB-I2C/SPI CONVERTER' text on a side-view label.
warnings: The 'CIRCUITRY' diagram (USB -> CONTROLLER -> I2C/GPIO, SPI/GPIO) is a functional block diagram with no reference designators or component values, so it was not extracted as a schematics entry.
The Host Bus Connector's two 12-position label rows have no printed pin numbers on this sheet; row/position labels here are based on left-to-right reading order, not printed numbering.
A generic form/document control stamp (SBL-0033 Rev. No:0 Date: 29.05.2023) is visible at the bottom left but was not used as drawing_number since it identifies the template, not this product.
